phase10ProductionManifestDecision.reason: Microsoft documents the add-in-only XML manifest as production-supported for Excel, PowerPoint, and Word; Phase 10 has no requirement that justifies a manifest-family migration.
phase10ProductionManifestDecision.baseManifestRule: Do not combine WordApi, ExcelApi, and PowerPointApi application-specific Sets in one base Requirements block.
phase10ProductionManifestDecision.hostScopedRequirementStrategy: Use host-scoped VersionOverrides/Requirements following Microsoft's multi-application requirement configuration guidance; validate the resulting XML with Microsoft's manifest validator before accepting the manifest change.
